jobs.title: Builder Developer II
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**The Builder-2 (Dev) Profile**

You are a full-stack agent engineer. You can take a complex business requirement and build the multi-step AI workflow that solves it, end to end, without someone breaking it down for you first.

**1. Core DNA**

* **AI-Native Workflow.** You use AI to accelerate development, testing and documentation as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place.
* **Agentic Implementation.** You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and long-running business logic.
* **Legacy-to-Modern Bridge.** You treat 20-year-old systems as puzzles for AI-driven modernization, not as someone else’s problem.
* **Evidence Over Confidence.** You don’t ship an agent because the demo went well. You ship it because you can show what it does on the edge cases — and you know your own error rate rather than claiming there isn’t one.

**2. What You Own**

**Your agent.** Design, build, debug, deploy, and keep running. Including the unglamorous parts: retries, state recovery, timeouts, what happens when the model is down.

**The evidence it works.** Before you refactor an undocumented module, you capture what it currently does — characterization tests, real inputs, real outputs. After, you show the behaviour matches. Your Builder 3 sets the standard; meeting it is your job, not theirs.

**Your blast radius.** You know exactly what your agent is permitted to touch, and you build so a wrong answer costs a review comment rather than a bad ledger entry.

**3. Your Elective Specialty (lean into one)**

* **The Agentic Architect (Systems)** — you don’t just build APIs, you build tool-calling interfaces and state management for agentic graphs that survive long-running business processes.
* **The UX/Interaction Builder (Product)** — the chatbox is just the beginning. You build generative UIs and browser-use agents that navigate existing portals to get work done.
* **The Data & Context Engineer (Data)** — master of the RAG pipeline. Vector stores, chunking strategy, and knowledge graphs that teach the AI how a Purchase Order relates to a GL entry.
* **The Reliability & Eval Engineer (QA)** — you move the team from prompt vibes to prompt engineering. DSPy for programmatic optimization, red-teaming agents to pressure-test financial logic.
* **The Infra & Agent-Ops Builder (DevOps)** — you build the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the thoughts of the AI.
* **The Domain Logic Translator (Business)** — you take 50 pages of accounting regulation and turn it into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* **Build execution agents.** Move beyond RAG into action — agents that navigate an ERP schema, find a data discrepancy and propose the fix.
* **Automate the untestable.** Wrap legacy business logic in modern tests and documentation using AI, starting with the modules everyone else has avoided.
* **Prove parity.** Capture what the old code does before you replace it, and show the new path matches — on the boring cases and the fiscal-calendar, multi-currency, partial-shipment ones.
* **Prompt engineering and evals.** Use frameworks like DSPy to move from vibes-based prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions.
* **Rapid prototyping.** Turn a “what if” into a working AI-driven feature in days, not months.
* **Fix your own agents in production.** Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again.

**What Good Looks Like**

*(Illustrative — real targets agreed with the hiring manager.)*

* **30 days:** Shipped your first agentic workflow into a real environment, however small.
* **90 days:** Owning a legacy module end to end — parity evidence, tests, deployment — with minimal supervision.
* **6 months:** Other Builders are reusing patterns you built. You’re the person people ask about one thing in particular.

**The Stack**

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, agentic coding tools, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Playwright, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent). And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.

**Who You Are**

* **You’ve shipped one.** You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work — not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did.
* **The early adopter.** You were using GPT-3 before it was cool and had a local model running the week it leaked. More time on r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub Trending and AI Twitter than on LinkedIn.
* **Agent-first thinker.** You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* **The manual-task hater.** You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you’ve already started drafting the automation.
* **Technically fearless.** A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn’t complexity, it’s a puzzle about to get solved. You aren’t intimidated by spaghetti code — you’re the one who brings the sauce.
* **Rigor over hype.** You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.

**Why Join Us**

* **The Final Boss of complexity.** ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. Automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain and you’ve mastered the hardest problem in software.
* **Agentic autonomy.** We don’t do tickets. We do missions. You’ll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win.
* **No red tape.** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a “Does It Work?” policy.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineering Lead - React js
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As a Senior Software Engineering Lead at Optum Technology, you will play a pivotal role across two high-impact initiatives that empower employees and enhance corporate operations. You will drive front-end architecture and user experience for Eva, an enterprise virtual agent designed to help employees quickly access information and perform administrative tasks, while also designing and delivering custom SharePoint solutions. Working across React-based user interfaces, streaming APIs, and intelligent employee tools, you will design, develop, and deploy scalable solutions that streamline enterprise workflows and elevate digital employee experience.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and deliver modern React-based user interfaces and custom SharePoint solutions tailored for enterprise employee engagement and administrative workflows
* Lead the front-end engineering for Eva, our employee virtual agent, implementing intuitive UI/UX design concepts, streaming API responses, and performance optimization techniques
* Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of AI
* Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate administrative tasks, and drive continuous product improvement
* Collaborate with cross-functional product managers, system architects, and UX design teams to translate complex requirements into clean, maintainable, and modular software components
* Evaluate emerging trends in AI technologies, web frameworks, and solution design to inform engineering decisions and strategic innovation
* Perform rigorous code reviews, ensure robust component packaging, and enforce high standards for code quality, scalability, and enterprise security
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of software engineering / application development experience
* 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
* 5+ years of strong proficiency in modern web development with React, including UI/UX design concepts, streaming API responses, performance optimization techniques, and component packaging
* 3+ years of experience designing, integrating, and consuming RESTful APIs and web services
* 2+ years of experience with version control systems (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing, customizing, and deploying custom SharePoint solutions
* Experience designing, developing, and optimizing APIs using Python and FastAPI
* Experience with relational database design, data access strategies, and query optimization
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment
* Understanding of AI application concepts, including effective prompting, token optimization, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) workflows, Agent-to-UI (A2UI) integration, and building AI agents

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Growth team is seeking engineers to help accelerate the adoption of Copilot and Microsoft 365. Our team is uniquely positioned at the strategic epicenter of Copilot, Agents, and Platform (CAP) for revolutionizing the productivity business by delivering embedded experiences across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc.) that drive the growth of our company’s cutting-edge generative AI solutions across the commercial and consumer spectrum. Our team tackles technical challenges across a diverse tech stack, with the solutions we deliver having a direct impact on the bottom line of the business. This role requires strategic and creative thinking, as well as a passion for building technical solutions that address customer needs.

We are a modern engineering organization that embodies industry best practices in Product-Led Growth (PLG). We are data-informed, hypothesis-driven, and rigorous in measuring outcomes to ensure undeniable customer and business impact. We collaborate closely with industry-leading PMs, designers, data scientists, user researchers, and marketers to build deep customer insights that inform the design of experiences used by hundreds of millions of people every day. We partner with teams across the company to deliver world-class services, and we create experiences that connect with customers across Microsoft products. We play a direct role in driving business growth and framing our business value to end users and our vibrant community of fans. We are looking for a **Principal Software Engineer** to join us.

Building a successful team involves creating an inclusive workplace where all people and ideas are welcome. We invest in the health of our team and take "how we work" as seriously as the impact we have on customers and the business. You don’t need to know everything when you join our team; just bring your growth mindset and willingness to learn, and we will provide mentorship and career growth to help you succeed.

You will build new experiences, lead experimentation, and use data to make informed decisions about release candidates. This role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth area for CAP while helping shape the engineering organization’s technical direction, culture, and values.

We are builders, explorers, and connectors and we are looking for a like-minded Software Engineers who thrives on driving big ideas from spark to scale. We are looking for candidates with a growth mindset, and someone who fosters collaboration with teammates and partners.

Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Job Description: Senior Full Stack Developer**

**Position Summary:** We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, with the ability to build scalable and high-performance applications. As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for leading the development and architecture of new features, ensuring the smooth integration of both front-end and back-end systems, and mentoring junior developers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Full Stack Development:**
  + Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web applications across the full stack (front-end and back-end).
  + Build reusable, testable, and efficient code using modern web technologies (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Angular, Golang, Kotlin).
  + Implement server-side logic, database management, and ensure data persistence and API development.
  + Develop APIs and services for integrations with other platforms and third-party services.
  + Ensure applications are mobile-responsive, user-friendly, and have optimal performance.
* **Architecture & Design:**
  + Contribute to the design and architecture of complex web applications, focusing on scalability, performance, and security.
  + Lead the design and implementation of software solutions, ensuring alignment with business needs and technical requirements.
  + Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  + Conduct code reviews to maintain code quality and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards.
* **Mentorship and Leadership:**
  + Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level developers.
  + Collaborate with cross-functional teams, guiding them on technical challenges and best practices.
  + Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the development team.
* **Collaboration & Communication:**
  + Work closely with front-end and back-end engineers, UX/UI designers, product managers, and QA teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  + Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives as part of an Agile team.
  + Communicate technical concepts and solutions effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Testing and Debugging:**
  + Write unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure the reliability and quality of the codebase.
  + Troubleshoot and debug application issues across both front-end and back-end environments.
  + Monitor the health and performance of applications in production and proactively address any issues.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  + Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices.
  + Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and processes that can improve the development workflow and application performance.
  + Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* **Technical Proficiency:**
  + Expertise in front-end technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and frameworks/libraries like React, Angular, or Vue.js
  + Strong back-end development experience using Kotlin, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java, or other relevant technologies.
  + Solid experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL), and familiarity with ORM tools.
  + Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL.
  + Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or similar.
  + Proficiency in version control systems, especially Git.
* **Development Tools & Practices:**
  + Strong understanding of software development methodologies, especially Agile (Scrum/Kanban).
  + Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  + Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps principles.
  + Experience with testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Jest, Mocha, Cypress, or similar).
* **Soft Skills:**
  + Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a passion for tackling complex technical challenges.
  + Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  + Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  + Proven ability to mentor and guide junior developers, fostering team growth and knowledge sharing.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of experience in full-stack web development.
* Experience with microservices architecture and serverless computing.
* Familiarity with front-end build tools and bundlers such as Webpack or Parcel.
* Knowledge of web security best practices.
* Familiarity with GraphQL and server-side rendering (SSR) frameworks.

Specialist, Business Analyst – AI Content Creation (Content Creation Storage)

* Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
About Digital Human Health (DHH)
  
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.

Act as hands-on business and product partner for AI-enabled content creation, working closely with business users and vendor teams to shape, test, and evolve GenAI and agentic capabilities, and building the internal knowledge needed to confidently own custom components as the platform landscape evolves.

* Support the AI Content creation workstream: experiment design, requirements, testing, and assessment of where Adobe capabilities can replace or complement custom-built components.

* Support the Adobe Firefly rollout across Human Health: access and onboarding inputs, playbook and enablement content, usage reporting, and user feedback loops.
* Work closely with content creators, brand teams, and reviewers to capture real feedback, prioritize the most important items, and turn them into fast, practical iterations.
* Flex across adjacent workstreams in the pillar (e.g., design system, guardrails/rules, AEM/DAM) as priorities shift.

* Maintain and prioritize backlogs in partnership with the Product Owner; support sprint planning, refinement, and release readiness.

* Facilitate UAT with business, brand, and compliance stakeholders; track defects, gaps, and fixes through to closure.

* Work hands-on with GenAI and agentic tools to test, configure, and validate capabilities (e.g., prompts, agent inputs/outputs, brand rules, assembly and validation steps).
* Sit close to business users during pilots and early rollout: observe real usage, unblock issues quickly, and feed priority learnings back into the backlog.
* Design and run structured experiments with clear scope, success criteria, test assets, and results (e.g., accuracy, false-flag rate, turnaround time, rework).
* Build a working understanding of component architecture, integrations, and APIs to have informed discussions with engineering and vendors.

Platform Vendor Collaboration (Adobe and Partners)

jobs.title: (Agentic) Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
  
  
You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end-to-end.
  
  
You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with platform PMs
  
  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success

**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
AI-native products or features that users love
  
  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.

Core capabilities
  
  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.

Nice to have
  
  

* Shipped copilot or AI-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Global Transportation Technology Services
jobs.description:
**Description**
Amazon moves millions of packages every day through the world's largest transportation network of planes, trucks, and delivery vehicles. Before any package can be assigned to a route, someone needs to design that network - figure out which lanes exist, how much capacity each node and lane can handle, and what changes are needed as demand shifts. That's what we build.
  
  
Global Transportation Tech Services (GTTS) creates software that manages the foundation of Amazon's outbound transportation network. Your work has direct financial impact on network efficiency and directly affects whether customers get their packages on time.
  
  
Here's what we actually do: We build the platform that transportation teams use to design and change the network - from evaluating new lanes to implementing them in production. We calculate how much capacity each node and lane will have, so the network can handle the volume. We identify where capacity will fall short and alert operators before it becomes a problem. We spot packages at risk of missing delivery and give operators tools to protect them. When a hurricane hits Florida or a snowstorm shuts down highways in Germany, our systems detect the disruption, protect customers by adjusting delivery promises, and help move volume to keep packages flowing.
  
  
The challenges are real: modeling capacity across a massive global network, managing thousands of network changes safely, predicting capacity gaps weeks in advance, detecting and responding to disruptions in real-time, and keeping systems running 24/7.
  
  
We regularly build new greenfield products while also modernizing existing systems. You'll have space to explore new technologies and approaches to solve customer problems. We work with AWS services, big data processing (Spark/Scala), optimization algorithms, machine learning models, and GenAI.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a leader on the team, you will be expected to operate at all levels, diving deep into the details while providing strategic inputs for the product portfolio. You will be a key player in driving strategic planning, project execution, driving operational excellence, and shaping up the solutions to achieve our vision. This is your opportunity to make a big impact and make history in the world of Global Transportation!
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
* Experience with end to end product delivery

jobs.description:
**Our Company**
  
  
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.
  
  
Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.
  
  
Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
  
  
**Who You Will Work With**
On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of product management experience, including 6+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers
* Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.
* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.
* Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities.

**What You Will Bring**

* Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time
* Hands-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e. g. , Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR).
* Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware.
* A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage.
* Vision to anticipate industry trends, next-generation backup architectures, AI-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

**Senior .NET Developer – Digi Rythu Bazaar**

**About the role**

We are hiring a **Senior .NET Developer with 6-10 years** of experience to own backend development for Digi Rythu Bazaar, a government-sector digital marketplace that connects farmers directly with consumers. The platform runs live Android and iOS apps backed by .NET APIs.

The next phase includes B2B bulk ordering for wholesale buyers, a catalogue for organic and natural farming products, and a move toward microservices on **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)**. You will design, build and scale these services alongside the mobile and web teams. We are looking for resources to **work from office all 5 days a week under full-time employment.**

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain **RESTful APIs in ASP.NET Core** that serve the Digi Rythu Bazaar Android and iOS apps.
* Lead decomposition of the existing backend into microservices and deploy them on AKS with Docker and Helm.
* Build the applications on modular framework in Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture.
* Extend the database schema for sub-variants farming products, including certification, traceability and product attributes.
* Write efficient SQL, stored procedures and EF Core models; tune queries for high-traffic marketplace workloads.
* Integrate payment gateways, SMS/OTP, notification services and government systems (e.g. Aadhaar-based or departmental APIs) securely.
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Apply security, audit-logging and data-protection standards expected of government-sector applications.
* Review code, mentor junior developers and set coding standards for the team.
* Work with product owners, mobile developers and department stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs.

**Required skills and experience**

* **6+ years** of professional development in **C# and .NET,** including **at least 3 years on .NET 6 or later (.NET 8/10 preferred)**.
* Strong hands-on experience with **ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core, Dapper, LINQ, Lambda** and dependency injection.
* **Solid SQL Server skills:** schema design, indexing, stored procedures and performance tuning.
* **Exposure to .NET MAUI or Xamarin, or to supporting Android and iOS release cycles.**
* Proven experience building and running **microservices with Docker and Kubernetes,** ideally AKS.
* Working knowledge of Azure services such as **App Service, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Blob Storage and Application Insights.**
* Experience with authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect and role-based access.
* Experience designing APIs consumed by mobile apps: versioning, pagination, caching and offline-friendly responses.
* Familiarity with messaging and caching (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Redis).
* Unit and integration testing with xUnit or NUnit and mocking frameworks.
* Git, code reviews and CI/CD in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Clear communication and the ability to work with non-technical government stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* **Prior work on government, agriculture, e-commerce or marketplace platforms.**
* Experience migrating legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET.
* Front-end experience with Blazor for reports and back-office portals.
* **Knowledge of API gateways (Azure API Management, YARP), Helm and infrastructure as code (Bicep or Terraform).**
* **Familiarity with Telugu-language or multilingual content handling.**
* Awareness of CERT-In guidelines, security audits and OWASP Top 10.

**Qualifications and how to apply**

* **B.Tech. / B.E. in Computer Science,** IT, Electronics or a related field, or MCA.
* Microsoft certifications such as Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) are a plus.

***Company Overview***  
*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance.* ***AutoRABIT official website***  
  
*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***  
  
***Job Role***

* *Engineering Operations and Pod Delivery*
* *Delivery model: cross-functional pods using Kanban. Pod composition and decision rights are agreed with Engineering and Product leadership*
* *Partner with the VP of Engineering to improve how engineering priorities move from planning to customer-ready delivery. Own the operating mechanisms that create visibility, resolve dependencies and support realistic commitments. This is a hands-on role requiring technical understanding, practical execution and influence across teams.*

***Key Responsibilities***

* ***Accountable execution.*** *Translate agreed priorities into plans with owners, capacity assumptions, dependencies, risks and measurable outcomes. Challenge commitments that lack a credible delivery path. Drive decisions and follow-through, escalating trade-offs to the right leaders before they become blockers.*
* ***Customer and release readiness.*** *Connect engineering plans to customer commitments and product outcomes. Coordinate readiness across Product, Engineering, QA, Security, SRE, Support and relevant enablement teams. Ensure release decisions have the required evidence and that unresolved risks have accountable owners.*
* ***Pod working structure.*** *Coordinate cross-functional pods around agreed product or customer outcomes. Establish each pod’s mission, accountable owner, required engineering and QA participation, and shared-service dependencies. Align Product, Security, SRE and Support involvement as needed. Coordinate capacity and cross-pod handoffs without creating duplicate reporting lines.*
* ***Kanban delivery.*** *Establish Jira Kanban boards with explicit workflow policies, entry and completion criteria, work-in-progress limits and visible blocked work. Facilitate replenishment, flow reviews and delivery forecasts using actual throughput and cycle-time evidence. Manage urgent work through an agreed expedite policy and help pods finish work before starting more.*
* ***Operational insight.*** *Establish baselines for lead time, cycle time, work ageing, delivery predictability and relevant quality indicators. Explain the causes behind trends and drive agreed interventions. Avoid treating story points or activity counts as stand-alone measures of individual productivity.*
* ***AI and continuous improvement.*** *Use approved AI and automation for reporting, documentation, follow-up and workflow analysis. Validate outputs, protect sensitive information and measure time saved or decision quality improved. Apply Lean, Agile and Kanban practices where they remove friction and help delivery.*
* ***Decision boundaries.*** *Facilitate prioritisation, dependency resolution and operating reviews. Product leaders remain accountable for product priorities, engineering leaders for technical execution and people management, and designated release owners for release decisions. Create clarity across these responsibilities rather than parallel authority.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.*

***Pride of Ownership***  
*Take pride in the customer outcomes delivered by the pods you support. Understand the product and its customer commitments, form evidence-based opinions about delivery priorities and risks, and drive decisions through to completion. Use AI and operational data thoughtfully while remaining accountable for their accuracy. Challenge assumptions constructively, listen to teams and adjust the operating model when evidence shows a better approach.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***  
***Required Skills (Mandatory)***

* *Typically 8 to 12 years in engineering operations, technical program management or a comparable software-delivery role, with demonstrated responsibility across multiple teams.*
* *Experience partnering directly with engineering leadership and turning ambiguous priorities into executable plans.*
* *Strong Jira and Kanban expertise, including workflow policies, work-in-progress limits, replenishment, blocked-work management and flow metrics.*
* *Experience coordinating cross-functional pods or comparable product teams, including ownership, capacity and dependencies.*
* *Understanding of software delivery, quality engineering, security, SRE and release processes.*
* *Evidence of resolving dependencies, improving delivery outcomes and influencing without direct authority.*
* *Strong analytical and written communication skills, including concise executive reporting.*
* *Practical use of AI or automation with evidence that it improved an operational workflow.*

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst III
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned Technical Business Analyst with a passion for transforming complex financial systems into streamlined, high-performing solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and finance, turning business challenges into smart, scalable IT innovations? If so, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in a globally connected, SAP-driven financial closing environment — and leave a lasting mark on how the world's (re)insurance industry reports its financials.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Technical Business Analyst**
, you will sit at the heart of our global financial closing ecosystem, acting as the critical bridge between business stakeholders and our SAP-based platform. You will not only maintain and enhance a sophisticated financial subledger solution, but you will also champion simplicity, standardization, and innovation. From shaping new functionality to validating, it through rigorous testing and live production runs, your fingerprints will be on every improvement we make. You'll engage continuously with a global user community — educating, aligning, and supporting teams across time zones and disciplines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with global stakeholders to capture business objectives and requirements, translating them into pragmatic, effective IT solutions
* Challenge complexity — act as a champion for standard components and push back on unnecessarily complicated solutions in favor of elegant, maintainable designs
* Establish yourself as a subject matter expert on SAP systems and financial closing processes, providing trusted guidance and mentorship to stakeholders and team members alike
* Drive end-to-end system changes and customizations through the full lifecycle — from solutioning and implementation through to testing and go-live
* Support quarterly close operations including incident handling, process documentation, and continuous improvement of E2E system workflows
* Engage and educate the global user community on an ongoing basis, ensuring alignment, adoption, and confidence in the platform
* Validate new and enhanced functionality during both testing phases and productive runs, ensuring quality and reliability at every step

The
**FPSL Subledger Liability**
team is an international product team made up of experienced professionals with diverse and complementary backgrounds. We provide the platform that enables global and local financial closings under IFRS for (re)insurance contracts. At the core of this platform is a robust SAP solution, embedded within an evolving technology landscape that enriches our data and ultimately produces financial statements for the quarterly finance closing process. We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values expertise, curiosity, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  
  
**About You**
You are a strategic and creative problem solver who thrives on turning complexity into clarity. Your strong interpersonal skills allow you to build trusted relationships across diverse, global teams, and your natural curiosity keeps you constantly learning and improving. You bring an ownership mindset to everything you do — self-driven, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. You are as comfortable diving into technical detail as you are facilitating a conversation with senior business stakeholders, and you bring both rigor and enthusiasm to every challenge.

* University degree in a technical, financial, or business discipline (or comparable qualification/experience)
* 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst working with IT systems in complex, enterprise environments
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with FPSL systems, including solid knowledge of IFRS 17 and its application in (re)insurance financial reporting
* Good working knowledge of SQL and the MS Office suite, including advanced Excel skills
* Proven experience delivering product changes and operations with end-to-end ownership, including requirements analysis, testing, process standardization, optimization, and documentation

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Basic knowledge of accounting and financial reporting principles, enabling effective communication with finance stakeholders
* Willingness and ability to learn a scripting language for formulating and automating test cases
* Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies, including experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for backlog management and sprint planning
* Experience working in global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones and cultures
* A continuous improvement mindset with the drive to proactively identify and implement enhancements to both processes and systems

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
Reporting to the IT&D Genesis Product Manager, the Senior Business Analyst plays a critical role in supporting the Genesis Procurement transformation programme. The role is responsible for detailed documentation and validation of business and functional requirements, supporting testing activities, and preparing high-quality training and enablement materials to support successful adoption of Genesis products. The Senior Business Analyst works closely with Product Managers, developers, data scientists, and Procurement stakeholders to translate business needs into clear user stories, process flows, and functional specifications. The role ensures solutions are well documented, thoroughly tested, and user-ready, enabling smooth deployment and sustainable value realisation.
  
  
Your responsibilities

* Lead detailed elicitation, analysis, and documentation of business and functional requirements.
* Document user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Maintain clear and structured documentation aligned to agile and product delivery standards.
* Ensure traceability between business requirements, user stories, and delivered functionality.

* Support test planning, scenario definition, and execution of system, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Validate delivered functionality against requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate defect triage with development teams and support resolution and retesting.

**Training and Enablement**

* Prepare training materials, user guides, SOPs, and quick reference documentation.
* Support delivery of training sessions and knowledge transfer to business users.
* Ensure end-user documentation reflects final solution design and operating model.

**Product & Delivery Support**

* Support the Product Manager in backlog refinement, sprint preparation, and delivery planning.
* Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Support governance, status reporting inputs, and stakeholder communications where required.

The experience we're looking for
  
  
****Essential****

* Knowledge of Procurement and/or Source-to-Pay processes.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst within digital, data, or transformation programmes.
* Strong experience documenting requirements using user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Experience supporting testing activities including UAT and defect management.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear documentation.

**Desirable**

* 8+ years of Experience working in Agile or product-led delivery environments.
* Exposure to AI, analytics, or automation-enabled solutions.
* Experience supporting enterprise change or transformation initiatives.

**Technical / Professional Qualifications:**
****Essential****

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience using delivery and collaboration tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence).
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).

**Desired**

* Certification or training in Business Analysis (e.g. CBAP, PMI-PBA).
* Certification or training in Agile / Scrum methodologies.

The skills for success
  
  
Business & Functional Documentation, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria, Process Mapping & Workflow Design, Stakeholder Management & Communication, Procurement / Source-to-Pay Knowledge, Testing & QA (UAT, Defect Management), Agile & Scrum Methodology, Backlog Refinement Support, Traceability Management, Training Material Development & Enablement, Cross-functional Collaboration, Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking, Tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Office), Data / AI / Automation Exposure
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. **Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.

 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.

 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

 

**About the role**

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The
**Senior Business Analyst**
(BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge.

* Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval.

* Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity.

* Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall.

* Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability.

* Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each.

* Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins.

* Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release.

* Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

 

**Deliverables Owned by This Role**

 

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams.

* Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD).

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

* Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report.

* Exception handling and business continuity procedure.

* Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover.

* Post-implementation benefit realisation report.

Bangalore

  

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

AI Specialists don’t get better by accident. Hill climbing is how we improve them. We test against real customer environments, find what’s failing, fix it, and test again. Now we want every AI Specialist team to climb this way, faster, and without needing us to run it for them. You’ll own the product and the program that make that happen.

* Own the hill climbing product roadmap and scale it across our priority AI Specialists and beyond.

* Cut the loop time from a shipped change to a clear, actionable quality verdict from weeks to days.
* Convert eval findings into prioritized fixes with specialist product teams, and stay with those teams until the fixes ship.
* Turn hill climbing into a method product teams can run on their own, with the tools, guides and defaults to do it well and without heavy support from our team.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Physical AI & Robotics
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

**Location & Flexibility**
--------------------------

**India Hybrid: Bengaluru**
---------------------------

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a **Group Product Manager** for the **Physical AI Robotics product team**. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.

Your application will stand out if you are demonstrably curious and have side work projects to showcase.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* 8-12 years in product management, including at least 2 in robotics, physical AI, AR/VR, autonomous systems, or data collection at scale.
* Own the roadmap for robotics data collection, setting direction and driving execution across engineering, design, operations, quality, and solutions.
* Assess demand for new capture modalities, then define the collection model, hardware, and tooling.
* Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.
* Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.
* Translate customer model requirements into collection designs, and evolving research into quality standards for egocentric data: pose accuracy, sync tolerance, occlusion handling, annotation schema, acceptance criteria.
* Spend time with collectors, session leads, and reviewers. When data underperforms in training, trace it back to the capture design or the tooling that produced it.
* Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.
* Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.
* Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..
* Technical depth to hold a real conversation with a research team.
* Direct experience with one or more of: egocentric or wearable data capture, teleoperation systems, robot data pipelines, multi-sensor collection rigs or similar setups
* Experience defining product vision and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

* Hands-on robotics background. Robotics, ML engineer on embodied models, teleoperation engineer, or similar.
* Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, or manipulation policy training, and the data those methods need.
* Experience managing distributed human operations, including crowd or contractor workforces.
* You have shipped something physical and understand calibration, sensor sync, and coordinate frames, and how they fail.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. jobs.description:
**Role**
- Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management Systems (FMS)

**Location**
- BLR/GGN

**About the Role**

Delhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.

As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system-driven execution.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.
* Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.
* Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.
* Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.
* Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.
* Drive execution across teams — Work closely with engineering, operations, supply, business, finance, and external partners. Navigate competing priorities, make trade-offs, and take initiatives from problem discovery through rollout and adoption.

**What You Bring**

* 4+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast-paced internet company.
* Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.
* Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.
* Hands-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.
* Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.
* Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.
* Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.

**Why This Role**

Freight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.

FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.

This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.

The Technology Service Desk is the front door to Digital & Tech for GSK colleagues worldwide and is delivered through an outsourced provider. This senior role owns the assurance and performance governance of the outsourced Tech Service Desk, managing the provider to agreed SLAs, XLAs and quality expectations and driving continuous improvement. A key part of the role is to drive the Service Desk modernisation agenda, increasing the use of AI and automation to accelerate shift left, expand effective self-service and deliver material improvements in colleague experience. It sets and refreshes SLAs and XLAs to ensure continuous stretch and improvement, and ensures a robust “voice of the customer” feedback-to-improvement cycle. Operating within GSK's largely outsourced, multi-sourced ecosystem, the role sets, monitors and governs standards and delivery discipline for the service outcome.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Desk Performance Assurance**

* Manage the outsourced Tech Service Desk provider to agreed SLAs, XLAs and quality expectations, holding the provider to account for outcomes.

**2. GENERAL JOB SUMMARY**

  

Aptean is seeking a multidisciplinary Experience Designer with a specialism in website personalisation. You will design experiences on Aptean.com that help visitors discover relevant solutions and take the right next step, adapting content and interactions to audience needs, industry, intent and customer relationship where reliable information is available.

  

Your remit spans UX, UI, content hierarchy and interaction design, from initial entry through subsequent pages and return visits. You will support a prioritised roadmap of more than 50 experiences, balancing commercial value, visitor needs and delivery effort. Working with Personalisation Specialists, the CRO Lead and content teams, you will take ideas through journey mapping, prototyping, implementation handover and improvement after launch.

**3. SCOPE**

  

Designs personalised variants and components across desktop, tablet and mobile while maintaining consistency with the Aptean.com design system and the default page. The role covers visual asset creation or adaptation, responsive and accessible design, build handover, pre-launch quality checks and collaboration with personalisation, CRO, product marketing and UX teams to deliver a high volume of detailed work on schedule.

You will own experience design and design specifications, with mentorship and standards within Aptean Design Studio. Personalisation Specialists will own audience configuration and Optimizely implementation. The CRO Lead will lead test strategy and statistical evaluation, with your input on hypotheses and interpretation. Martech and development colleagues will own identity, data connections and technical performance. Content and product marketing partners will support messaging and accuracy.

* Review builds for journey continuity, audience scenarios, responsive behaviour and WCAG accessibility requirements, alongside visual accuracy. Design appropriate defaults when consent or data is unavailable.

Brio is a specialized global commercial real estate asset services platform that manages and supports Blackstone’s Real Estate Debt Strategies business (“BREDS”) across the globe. Today, BREDS has more than $77 billion in investor capital across high yield / opportunistic real estate credit funds, a publicly traded Mortgage REIT, CMBS securities and insurance capital. Brio is a sophisticated real estate credit solutions provider that enhances value for investors and supports BREDS across key functions, including asset management, transactions, capital markets, surveillance, portfolio management and legal & compliance. Brio provides critical infrastructure and capabilities for BREDS to allow for effective investments and management of its global portfolio.

Blackstone’s scale, with roughly 12,700 real estate assets and over 240 portfolio companies, enables them to invest in dynamic sectors positioned for long-term growth. The firm seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by building strong businesses that deliver lasting value.
