This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.
  
  
This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding & Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player-manager who both delivers and develops.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day-to-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Team Development**

* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role)**
Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:
  
  

* Core HCM, Onboarding & Workday Help: Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.

CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company.

This role is part of our
**Discrete Manufacturing**
business unit, which delivers software solutions for manufacturers that produce components and assemblies that become part of larger products. Serving small through enterprise manufacturers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, industrial equipment, and engineered products, Discrete Manufacturing focuses on modern execution-connecting planning, production, traceability, and automation to help manufacturers run more resilient, efficient, and predictable operations.

**CAI India**

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust.

**About the Role**

The Product Owner will operate within our AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) model, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, and AI coding agents (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI-based tools) to translate manufacturing and customer needs into precise specs and intents that AI agents can implement directly. Rather than authoring only traditional user stories, this role owns Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for the team — writing unambiguous specifications, reviewing AI-generated plans and code before execution proceeds, and making the human judgment calls that AI-DLC defers to people. This is a hands-on execution role focused on driving agentic delivery of MES capabilities that improve shop-floor efficiency, visibility, and control, while maintaining human oversight and accountability at every stage of the AI-DLC cycle.

Location

* Bangalore, India – Hybrid In Office

Responsibilities

* Own the MES product backlog as a set of AI-DLC intents and units of work, ensuring each is scoped precisely enough for agentic execution within a delivery cycle (bolt).
* Translate high-level MES product strategy into precise specs, acceptance criteria, and workflows detailed enough for AI agents to implement directly.
* Work closely with Engineering, QA, and UX — often in mob-programming/pod sessions with AI agents — to refine specs, clarify requirements, and remove ambiguity before and during delivery cycles.
* Review and validate AI-generated plans, user stories, and implementation proposals before execution proceeds, acting as the human decision-maker in the AI-DLC oversight loop.
* Make day-to-day scope, priority, and risk-acceptance decisions for the team, deferring to Engineering only the technical calls AI-DLC reserves for specialists.
* Define acceptance criteria and evaluation checks ("evals") that AI agents and QA use to verify completed work against business intent, and provide timely feedback and sign-off.
* Collaborate with stakeholders (Product Management, Implementation, Support, Customer Success) to translate plant and user feedback into new specs and backlog priorities.
* Monitor MES usage, defects, and AI-DLC cycle metrics to identify improvements and incremental value opportunities, feeding learnings back into specs.
* Maintain transparency on team progress, AI-generated changes, risks, and dependencies through clear communication and reporting.
* Ability to build Product markdown files to provide AI agents contextual background to the MES product.

Required Qualifications

* 4–7 years of experience in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role on software development teams.
* Hands-on experience with LLM tools such as Claude, Gemini, or OpenAI, used in a professional product or development context.
* Working knowledge of Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — able to write specs precise enough for AI agents to implement directly.
* Strong experience writing user stories/Intents, defining acceptance criteria, and managing backlogs in tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Solid understanding of software methodologies (Scrum or Kanban) and how to adapt them to agentic, AI-DLC-based delivery.
* Ability to understand technical concepts relevant to MES (APIs, integrations with ERP/PLM/SCADA, data models) and communicate effectively with both engineers and AI agents.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) methodology is a plus.
* AI & Technical Fluency — comfortable evaluating AI-generated code, plans, and test coverage well enough to approve or redirect them.
* Experience with AI-DLC & agentic delivery — working in mob-programming/pod formats with cross-functional teams and AI coding agents.
* Data-driven product management — using shopfloor KPIs, usage analytics, and AI-DLC cycle metrics to shape backlog priorities.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Business Analyst in Transformation Delivery Hub, you’ll play a key role in accelerating delivery of projects and programs, by gathering and clarifying requirements, analysing processes, and translating business objectives into actionable specifications for delivery teams, whilst aligning with stakeholder expectations to add real value.
  
  
The
**Business Analyst**
leads business analysis activities for medium-complexity initiatives, workstreams and cross-functional change programs. The role is responsible for investigating business problems, evaluating solution options, managing requirements, and driving process improvements to deliver measurable business outcomes. Working with a broad range of stakeholders, the analyst translates business needs into actionable solutions, influences decision-making and ensures alignment between business objectives and delivery outcomes. They operate with a high degree of independence and are expected to mentor junior analysts, contribute to BA best practices and support successful change adoption.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type:**
Permanent
  
  
**Role Location**
: Acacia, Manyata Tech Park
  
  
**Work Hours**
: 7.00 am to 4.00 pm
  
  
**Note 1:**
The standard work schedule for this role is 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. However, candidates are expected to remain flexible and may be required to work earlier shifts, depending on project commitments and scheduled stakeholder engagements or meetings.
  
  
**Note 2:**
There are multiple vacancies available for this role. Successful candidates may be matched to any of the available positions based on their experience, skills and business needs.
  
  
**What will your day look like?**
As a Business Analyst, you will:
  
  

* Lead the analysis of complex business situations to identify root causes, opportunities, risks and recommendations for improvement.
* Conduct feasibility assessments and evaluate solution options by analysing business impacts, costs, benefits, risks and strategic alignment.
* Own end-to-end requirements management activities for medium-complexity initiatives, including elicitation, prioritisation, traceability and change management.
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops and discussions to build alignment, resolve competing priorities and support informed decision-making.
* Develop and maintain business, process and data models that support business understanding, solution design and strategic decision-making.
* Analyse current and future-state business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, customer outcomes and operational performance.
* Support development of business cases, benefits measures and value realisation approaches to ensure successful business outcomes.
* Lead solution validation activities, including acceptance criteria definition, UAT oversight and business sign-off activities.
* Assess business impacts arising from process, technology or organisational change and support implementation and adoption activities.
* Apply and promote organisational methods, standards, tools and governance practices to deliver consistent, high-quality analysis outcomes.

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* Business Analysis & Problem Solving like business situation analysis, root cause analysis, solution evaluation
* Requirements Management including elicitation, prioritisation, traceability, change management
* Business Process & Data Analysis and suggesting process improvements,
* Business and data modelling
* Facilitation and Influencing including negotiation and conflict resolution
* Solution validation and testing including UAT oversight and business sign off
* Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies
* Process modelling tools (Visio, BPMN, data modelling or equivalent

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us? (Bengaluru GCC)**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 126475.
  
  
**Job Posting End Date**
27/10/2026, 11.59pm, (Melbourne Australia)

jobs.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**India T&M Special Bonus:**
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
  
  
Senior Business Analyst – Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud Advanced Migration
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with deep Salesforce CPQ expertise to lead discovery and requirements work for a migration from Salesforce CPQ to Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA). You will bridge business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring the migration preserves existing business logic while unlocking RCA's native capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead end-to-end discovery sessions with sales ops, finance, and IT stakeholders to document current-state CPQ configuration, workflows, and customizations
* Produce detailed as-is process maps covering product catalog, pricing rules, discount schedules, quote templates, approval workflows, and contract lifecycle
* Identify gaps between CPQ functionality and RCA's data model (Products, Attributes, Price Books, Transaction Line Items) and document migration impact
* Define to-be business processes aligned to RCA's native features — including Product Catalog, Dynamic Revenue Orchestration, and Subscription Management
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the implementation team
* Collaborate with architects to assess custom Apex, triggers, and integrations in the current CPQ org and recommend migration or re-build strategies
* Facilitate UAT planning, write test scripts, and coordinate sign-off with business owners
* Maintain a traceability matrix linking CPQ configurations to RCA equivalents throughout the project lifecycle
* Manage stakeholder expectations around feature parity, timeline, and data migration scope

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years as a Business Analyst on Salesforce platform projects
* 3+ years hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (product rules, pricing rules, quote templates, approval chains, amendments, renewals)
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (formerly Industries CPQ / Vlocity) or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on RCA's object model
* Strong understanding of Quote-to-Cash (QTC) and Order-to-Revenue (OTR) processes
* Experience documenting complex business rules in decision tables, process flows (BPMN or similar), and functional specs
* Proficiency with tools like Confluence, JIRA, Lucidchart, or equivalent
* Ability to read and interpret Salesforce configuration (flows, validation rules, field mappings) without writing code

Nice to Have
  
  

* Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification
* Salesforce Revenue Cloud or Industries CPQ certification
* Experience with data migration projects (CPQ quote/contract data to RCA)
* Familiarity with Salesforce DX and metadata-driven deployments
* Prior involvement in a CPQ-to-RCA or CPQ-to-Vlocity migration

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong facilitation skills — comfortable running workshops with mixed technical and non-technical audiences
* Able to push back constructively when requirements conflict with platform constraints
* Detail-oriented with a track record of keeping documentation current through project changes

**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. jobs.description:
**What We Do**
msg global is a consulting and system integration company with a strong focus on the insurance and reinsurance industry. We support our clients in designing, transforming, and implementing integrated IT architectures across end‑to‑end business processes. With deep industry expertise, we deliver high‑quality SAP‑based solutions tailored to the specific requirements of insurance and reinsurance organizations.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Business Analyst, you will collaborate closely with msg global project teams and customer stakeholders to deliver SAP for reinsurance implementations. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Analyzing, specifying, testing, and documenting reinsurance business processes
* Designing integrated and sustainable system landscapes
* Participating in process flow analysis, redesign, and business process optimization
* Designing transition maps, roadmaps, implementation, integration, and migration strategies
* Providing functional consulting expertise to reinsurance clients
* Defining best practices and evaluating third‑party solution alternatives as part of functional design documents
* Coordinating with business process owners and technical teams to design, customize, and implement SAP for reinsurance solutions
* Supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Participating in training, design, documentation, and delivery activities in alignment with the Project Manager
* Contributing to internal projects as required
* Traveling to client locations up to 80% of the time

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced and motivated professional with strong domain and consulting skills, including:
  
  

* Excellent knowledge of Reinsurance and insurance business processes, particularly for P&C lines of business
* Several years of experience in business consulting and package‑based implementation projects
* Strong understanding of integrated IT architectures and SAP implementation methodologies (e.g., ASAP)
* Ability to manage complex initiatives with minimal supervision
* Very strong analytical, conceptual, and problem‑solving skills
* A proactive mindset with a strong willingness to learn
* Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic work environment
* Strong customer focus and a service‑oriented, self‑driven approach to work
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Experience working directly with clients, business stakeholders, and functional teams
* SAP for Insurance/Reinsurance knowledge is an added advantage

**What We Offer**

* A place where individuals are equally valued and where diversity and cultural differences are cherished.
* A global team of highly respected developers and industry experts where you can make a difference.
* Competitive salaries and a broad range of benefits, some of which are highlighted below.
* The opportunity to work on complex and challenging reinsurance transformation projects
* Exposure to global clients and collaboration with experienced international teams
* A key role in shaping business processes and IT architectures for leading reinsurance organizations
* A professional environment that values expertise, independence, and continuous learning
* Opportunities to contribute to both client projects and internal initiatives
* Career growth within a specialized reinsurance consulting organization

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance: We provide hospitalization and non-hospitalization benefits like annual medical screening and mental health assistance program for employees and their dependents.
* Employee Wellbeing: We provide various options for sport and recreation benefits.
* Job for Friends: Get your friends on board through our employee referral program, and we will reward you.
* Flexible Working: We offer flexible work schedules, including flexible start and end times as well as remote and/or hybrid work.
* Anniversary & Success Milestones: We celebrate your work anniversaries and success by rewarding your loyalty and dedication.
* Gift Vouchers: We share your happiness with you and provide vouchers for newborns, wedding, work anniversaries, annual and festival gifts.
* Team Events: We celebrate our success with team-building activities throughout the year.
* Training and Development: We provide a broad training portfolio for personal and professional growth, including unlimited access to course platform to all our employees.
